goal: Send a transactional email with a from address, two recipients, a subject, an HTML body and a plain-text fallback, and return the id of the sent email or throw with the error message if sending failed.

Send an email with a PDF attachment from an in-memory buffer, a reply-to address, a CC recipient, and a custom header for tracking.
Send personalised welcome emails to a list of up to 100 users in a single request and return the ids.
Schedule an email to be sent tomorrow at 9am UTC, then reschedule it an hour later, then cancel it.
Add a contact with first and last name to an audience, mark another contact as unsubscribed, and list all contacts in the audience.
Register a sending domain, read back the DNS records needed to verify it, and trigger verification.
Send an order confirmation email so that retrying the same request after a network failure does not send it twice, and tag the email with the order id for later lookup.
